notes: The reference is a levelling combat game rather than a region to wander, so this is RPG with Adventure second for the island-hopping and secrets, exactly the reading the skill gives this prompt. Shape is world-open-biomes because the First Sea's structure is islands whose enemy level and reward climb the further out you sail, and the author asked for an island-for-island replica of that one sea, so I kept the shape and overrode its P4 to a single continuous ocean rather than splitting the islands into separate maps. Preset Action RPG keeps its starter towns, shop clusters, fenced mob nests and spawn emitters, but I swapped its world-hub-dungeon shape out because the First Sea has no instanced dungeons, and added fruit spawn nodes and island landmarks. Deciding without a user: the archipelago carries a CHECK because a faithful replica includes the floating sky islands above the sea, which is the one case where the play volume can self-occlude, and I left out level-gate blockades since progression here is a difficulty gradient across the water.
